elements.description: The agent's screen, live: its clicks and typing drawn on top, a caption per step, and Pause / Take over.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: What the agent did, oldest first, in the frame's pixels – the last one is where the pointer is now

properties.name: src
properties.description: The latest frame as an image URL

properties.name: source
properties.description: A live element to show instead – a

properties.name: frameWidth
properties.description:
The frame's width in its own pixels – the actions' coordinate space. Unset: the image's, video's or canvas's own.
The screen takes the frame's shape and the overlays follow it; give a stream of the same shape (a different one
is letterboxed inside the frame, and actions land on the frame, not on the picture)

properties.name: frameHeight
properties.description: The frame's height in its own pixels

properties.name: heading
properties.description: What the agent is doing overall – e.g. "Booking a table for four"

properties.name: caption
properties.description: The step's caption – unset uses the latest action's `caption`

properties.name: steps
properties.description: How many steps there are, when known

properties.name: agent
properties.description: The name on the pointer's flag – e.g. "Operator"; unset shows the flag only for typing, keys and scrolls

properties.name: color
properties.description: The pointer's color – defaults to the accent

properties.name: paused
properties.description: The agent is paused – the screen dims and says so

properties.name: control
properties.description: Who drives the screen; "user" after Take over

properties.name: ended
properties.description: The run is over: Finished, no pointer, no Pause or Take over

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-paused-change
events.description: Pause or Resume was pressed ({ paused }: LiveViewPausedChange); cancelable

events.name: tc-control-change
events.description: Take over or Hand back was pressed ({ control }: LiveViewControlChange); cancelable

events.name: tc-screen-click
events.description: While you have control, a click on the screen ({ x, y }: LiveViewScreenClick, frame pixels)

slots.name: screen
slots.description: Your own stream (an element with `slot="screen"`) – it fills the screen, under the overlays

props.name: title
props.description: What the agent is doing overall – the header's title

props.name: screen
props.description: Your own stream – a

props.name: paused
props.description: The agent is paused. Controlled when defined; otherwise the component keeps it, starting from `defaultPaused`

props.name: defaultPaused
props.description: Whether the agent starts paused, when `paused` isn't controlled

props.name: control
props.description: Who drives the screen. Controlled when defined; otherwise kept by the component, from `defaultControl`

props.name: defaultControl
props.description: Who drives the screen at first, when `control` isn't controlled

props.name: onControlChange
props.description: Take over or Hand back was pressed

props.name: onScreenClick
props.description: While you have control: a click on the screen, in frame pixels – forward it to the agent's browser

changelog: `tc-live-view` – the agent's screen (frames, a live video or canvas, or your own content) with its pointer, clicks, typing and keys drawn on top, a step caption, and Pause / Take over; your clicks are reported in frame pixels while you have control.
